title: M&T Bank Celebrates Grand Opening of New Branch in Torrington, Connecticut
summary: New standalone branch on Pineridge Road reinforces M&T Bank's long-term commitment to the Torrington community TORRINGTON, Conn., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- M&T Bank (NYSE: MTB) today...
body_markdown:
***New standalone branch on Pineridge Road reinforces M&T Bank's long-term commitment to the Torrington community***


TORRINGTON, Conn.


, Sept. 24, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[M&T Bank](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782686-1&h=3567141281&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mtb.com%2Fpersonal%2Fchecking-accounts%3Fch%3Dpsb%26campaignid%3D291815546%26targetid%3Dkwd-78890348702901%3Aloc-71141%26adid%3D78890168318258%26matchtype%3De%26addisttype%3Do%26adgroupid%3D1262239962324866%26utm_source%3Dmicrosoft%26utm_medium%3Dcpc%26utm_term%3Dm%252520%252526%252520t%252520bank%26utm_campaign%3D291815546%257Cqapk31mswr%26msclkid%3Dea999570b9bd1337786bfc2e3ca37896&a=M%26T+Bank) (NYSE: MTB) today announced the grand opening of a new full-service branch at 25 Pineridge Road in Torrington, Connecticut. The new location reflects M&T Bank's long-term investment in and commitment to the Torrington community, while furthering its mission to expand access to financial services for residents, families and small businesses.


The 2,400-square-foot freestanding branch combines modern conveniences with personalized service, offering a full range of banking services, including teller assistance, a drive-thru, a walk-up ATM and private offices for financial consultations. Thoughtfully designed to support the needs of both consumers and business customers, the branch provides access to everyday banking services, mortgage solutions and small business banking expertise.


"Our new Torrington branch was designed with the customer in mind and reflects the strong relationships we've built within this community and with the customers we are privileged to serve," said Michael Weinstock, Hartford Regional President for M&T Bank. "This location strengthens our ability to provide trusted financial guidance, personalized service and local expertise to the individuals, families and businesses that make Torrington such a special place. We look forward to providing enhanced banking experiences and continuing to be a strong partner to the Torrington community for years to come."


As part of M&T Bank's long-term commitment to Torrington, The M&T Charitable Foundation is donating $3,000 to the[Friendly Hands Food Bank](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782686-1&h=861285948&u=https%3A%2F%2Ffriendlyhandsfoodbanknwct.org%2F&a=Friendly+Hands+Food+Bank) , an organization dedicated to combating food insecurity, preventing food waste and ensuring that neighbors in need have access to nutritious meals. This contribution will help expand access to essential food and support services for individuals and families across the region. The investment reflects M&T's ongoing commitment to strengthening local communities and supporting organizations that address critical needs and create opportunities for individuals and families to thrive.


"Community partnerships play a critical role in helping us meet the growing needs of our neighbors," said Karen Thomas, Executive Director, Friendly Hands Food Bank. "We see firsthand how important community support for local families is, and we are thankful for M&T Bank's generosity and ongoing dedication to Torrington. We are honored to be part of this milestone and believe that together, we can make a meaningful difference in the lives of those who need it most."


**About M&T Bank** M&T Bank Corporation is a financial holding company headquartered in Buffalo, New York. M&T's principal banking subsidiary, M&T Bank, provides banking products and services with a branch and ATM network spanning the eastern U.S. from Maine to Virginia and Washington, D.C. Trust-related services are provided in select markets in the U.S. and abroad by M&T's Wilmington Trust-affiliated companies and by M&T Bank. For more information on
